Package io.telekom.orchest.api.core.model.bpmn.node

Class EventNode

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.api.core.model.bpmn.node.BaseNode
io.telekom.orchest.api.core.model.bpmn.node.EventNode
public class EventNode extends BaseNode
Represents an Event node in a BPMN process. Events can be start events, end events, intermediate catch/throw events, or boundary events.
